instructions: If your harness can dispatch the agent type natively, use the native tool call rather than AGX. Bounded reads, summaries, and single-file checks are not delegation tasks - do them in context. Policy lives in docs/SUBAGENT-ROUTING.md; this file is the machine-readable half.

implementer.instructions: The daily driver. Implementation and bug fixing; every repository edit.

planner.instructions: Planning and specs, usually user-invoked. Plans and specs get reviewed through a different harness from the author.

monitor.instructions: A wrapper/dispatch slot: owns a PR through CI, review providers, fix loops, and merge. Dispatches and relays, never does the work itself.

reviewer.instructions: Never the author's harness. This is a preference order, not a caller mapping: the resolver drops any entry whose harness equals --author-harness case-insensitively and takes the first survivor. Sol leads because the implementer is opus-5, so most work is Claude-authored; Codex-authored work falls through to opus-5 high.
